title: Omulangirizi w’Amataba Amanene
intro: Omuntu ono ssekinnoomu yayimirira ng’empagi y’okugumiikiriza okumala ebyasa bingi, ng’ayita ekibiina ky’abantu abajeemera eri ekitangaala ky’amazima ate nga kyolekedde okusekererwa n’okugaanibwa. Wadde ng’ebizibu byali biyitiridde n’obuzito bw’obubaka obukwata ku milembe, omuweereza ono yasigala munywevu mu bubaka bwabwe okutuusa ekiragiro ekisembayo lwe kyafulumizibwa.
clues: Namala emyaka mwenda mu ataano nga mpita abantu bange mu kkubo ery’obutuukirivu, emisana n’ekiro, mu kyama ne mu lujjudde.
Nalabula abantu bange ekibonerezo ekiruma, naye ne bateeka engalo mu matu gaabwe ne beebikka ebyambalo byabwe olw’amalala.
Nalagirwa okuzimba ekintu ekinene ennyo wansi w’amaaso ga Mukama wange agaali gatunula, wadde nga tewaaliwo mazzi galabika.
Nga nkola, abakulembeze b’abantu bange ne bayitawo ne banjerega, naye ne mbagamba nti mu bbanga ttono ffe tujja kuba tubasekerera.
Nasaba omubiri gwange n’omusaayi gwange okunneegattako, naye ne basalawo okunoonya obuddukiro ku lusozi nga balowooza nti lujja kubawonya omuyaga ogwali gugenda gulinnya.
Emmeeri yange yatuuka n’okuwummulira ku lusozi Judi oluvannyuma lw’ensi okumira amazzi gaayo n’eggulu ne likomya enkuba.

arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
